intro.fallback: In order to officially obtain the rank of genin, Academy students must be organised into groups of three to undergo a field evaluation administered by a jōnin, who would be their squad leader should they pass.
On the day of organisation, Naruto made sure to have a good breakfast, and headed off to the academy, where the groups were to be decided.
Upon arriving there, Naruto showed off his forehead protector to the other students, who thought he had failed.
